Brunswick, Merri‑bek

Brunswick is a northern Melbourne suburb inside the Merri-bek council area. There are roughly 24,473 residents in Brunswick. From Dallas 3047 it is routine range, and Brunswick is priced at the same rates as the rest of Merri-bek.

Around 20 people a month look for this in Brunswick by name. That is why Brunswick is a page and most of Merri-bek is not. There are roughly 50 monthly searches for gutters in Brunswick too. On a Brunswick job the two are almost always done together.

Brunswick West next door has a completed job on record. Brunswick itself does not. Next door is next door. Nothing here is presented as work done in Brunswick.

Height

Access decides the price

  • Ground floorStraightforward. The only variable is how much glass there is.
  • Second storey, clear beneathReached from the ground with a pole. A modest loading on the Brunswick rate rather than a separate job.
  • Second storey, obstructed beneathA deck, a pool or dense planting under the window. Ladder work, and priced differently.
  • Three storeys and upAn access method, and sometimes a permit. Facade cleaning.

Balustrade and pool glass

More glass outside than in

  • It is glass tooFrameless balustrade, pool fencing and stacker doors are usually a larger area than the windows on a Brunswick house.
  • And it marks fasterWeather on both faces, hands all over it, and splash and sunscreen on anything near a pool.
  • The spigots matterStainless fixings tea stain, and a clean panel above a stained spigot looks worse than before.
  • Same visit, much cheaperThe setup is already paid for. Booking it separately pays the travel twice.

Screens and tracks

The most common exclusion

  • Ask about the screensThey are the single biggest visible difference on an older Brunswick property and the most common exclusion.
  • And the tracksThe channel under a sliding door collects grit and holds it. It is what makes a finished job look finished.
  • And the framesPowder coated aluminium holds its own film. On a white frame it shows badly against clean glass.
  • Then compare quotesOnce everybody is pricing the same scope, two numbers that looked far apart usually are not.
